greptile.text: Paraphrase: Summarizes the PR as a refactor of group membership management, with dedicated add/remove member endpoints, paginated member lists, and route changes that defer loading to the model's findMembers(). It flags race conditions in route loading, missing error handling in async operations, and incomplete templates. Confidence score: 2/5.
"logic: HTTP method mismatch - test uses PUT but remove_member action expects DELETE" Suggests changing the xhr call from :put to :delete.
"style: Grammar: should be "strips spaces from the group name""
"style: Grammar: should be "ignores name change on automatic group""
Paraphrase: Logic warning that the findMembers() call is now asynchronous and unhandled, so the controller may not have member data immediately, creating a race condition.
Paraphrase: Logic warning that findMembers() is async but controller setup continues immediately, so templates expecting member data may render before it is available.
"style: Using == instead of === for comparison - should use strict equality"
Paraphrase: Logic warning that the template looks incomplete. The matching JavaScript expects Select2 multi-select integration, but the template is a plain input with no Ember bindings.
"style: The itemView syntax is deprecated in newer Ember versions - consider using {{#each}} with component syntax instead"
Paraphrase: Style note that params[:offset].to_i may turn nil into 0, and suggests (params[:offset] || 0).to_i for an explicit default, as done for limit.
Paraphrase: Logic warning that the automatic variable should be member.automatic or passed explicitly from the parent, since the current reference may be ambiguous.
